evidence.title: Headroom | AI usage in your Mac's menu bar

name: Headroom
summary: Mac menu bar app that shows what's left in Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok, when limits reset, and API spend.
description: A macOS menu bar app that shows remaining Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok usage, when each limit resets, and API spend, using the accounts already signed in on the Mac. An iPhone companion is mentioned; free, macOS 15+, no app analytics.
contains: menu bar app for macOS, with an iPhone companion
shows remaining Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok limits and reset times
tracks API spend next to usage limits
menu bar pills per provider, configurable in Settings
Mac widgets with selectable meter styles
optional notifications before a limit resets
